title: Safety check: prevent re-triggering ingest of files

cues.en: So, this time around, a very short helper function, and it's just a safety check.
cues.zh: 這堂課要寫一個非常短的輔助函式，只是安全檢查。

cues.en: Imagine if you will, that we have the watcher running.
cues.zh: 假設我們已經啟動監看器，

cues.en: So, we finished our code, we have the watcher running, and then someone drops a file inside the process directory itself, okay?
cues.zh: 程式寫好了，監看器正在執行，這時有人把檔案直接放進 processed 目錄，

cues.en: Not into the documents directory, but into the process directory.
cues.zh: 不是 documents，而是 processed。

cues.en: That move will actually fire a moved event, and that might, possibly, ingest a file that was moved into the process directory, which is not what the user would want, and we just
cues.zh: 這個移動操作會觸發 moved 事件，可能導致系統再次匯入移入 processed 的檔案，這不是使用者想要的，因此只

cues.en: need a safety check, just a guard, and it's a really, really short function.
cues.zh: 需要一個保護用的安全檢查，函式真的非常短。

cues.en: So, let's get that out of the way, because we're going to need it before too long.
cues.zh: 先把它寫好，因為很快就會用到。

cues.en: So, back over at ingest.py, at the very top of the file, after this helper method, hashBytes, okay?
cues.zh: 回到 ingest.py 最上方，在 _hash_bytes 輔助函式後面，

cues.en: I'm just going to add a very short two-line function here.
cues.zh: 新增一個很短、只有兩行的函式。

cues.en: def, and I'll call it underscore, is underscore under, because if it's under the documents directory, we want to ignore it, okay?
cues.zh: def，命名為 _is_under，因為如果它位於要忽略的目錄之下，就不應再處理。

cues.en: And all it's going to take is the path, which is type-inted to path, and the root, which is also type-inted to path, okay?
cues.zh: 它只接收 path 和 root，兩者型別都標註為 Path。

cues.en: And it returns a Boolean. Very simple.
cues.zh: 回傳布林值，非常簡單。

cues.en: All we have to say here is, return path.resolve, right there, okay?
cues.zh: 內容只要 return path.resolve，

cues.en: With opening and closing parentheses.
cues.zh: 記得左右括號，

cues.en: Dot is underscore relative underscore to, okay?
cues.zh: 再呼叫 .is_relative_to，

cues.en: And then we put root.resolve, with opening and closing parentheses, as its parameter, okay?
cues.zh: 參數是 root.resolve()，同樣記得括號。

cues.en: So, this will return true if somebody drops something into the process directory, which happens to be set to be inside the documents directory, as I have it set, otherwise it'll return false.
cues.zh: 所以，若有人把檔案放到 processed 目錄中，這裡會回傳 True；依我的設定，它位於 documents 之下。否則回傳 False。

cues.en: So, a little short helper function, okay?
cues.zh: 這就是一個簡短的輔助函式。

cues.en: And I know this is a very short lecture, but I wanted to get this out of the way by itself.
cues.zh: 我知道這堂課很短，但想把它獨立處理完，

cues.en: And again, this is just a safety check, which is always a good idea.
cues.zh: 同樣只是安全檢查，而安全檢查一向是好習慣。

cues.en: Okay, let's move on.
cues.zh: 我們繼續。
